tasks.title: Existing-provider request and streaming lifecycle fixtures
tasks.definition_of_done: Fixture tests enumerate the existing provider family matrix (Anthropic, OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, OpenRouter, Mistral, Gemini, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, and Vertex). For each family, tests assert the exact request JSON, headers, and body shape for a representative text request through the production Provider::stream adapter path; where lifecycle coverage already exists, this task extends the existing fixture file instead of creating duplicate lifecycle suites. The suite drains each adapter stream to observe Start, text deltas, content/text end where the shared stream model represents it, terminal finish/done, provider-specific finish/stop-reason mapping, and the shared StopReason result. Usage normalization, provider error taxonomy, retry semantics, and cancellation behavior are covered by later Phase 12 tasks; any such assertions in this task are smoke coverage only and must not close those later scenarios. Providers without a baseline text lifecycle feature have a named negative or capability assertion instead of a silent gap. Tests use local mock HTTP or fixture streams only and never require API keys.
